title: When Calls the Heart Season 14 Trailer Teases Elizabeth and Nathan's Wedding
excerpt:
Hope Valley is preparing for a long-awaited ceremony.
Abigail Stanton's return gives fans another reason to watch.
body_md:
Hope Valley is getting ready for a wedding. A new trailer for When Calls the Heart Season 14 offers fans an early look at the next chapter for Elizabeth Thornton and Nathan Grant, whose engagement finally arrived at the end of Season 13. The promotional footage has prompted an enthusiastic response from longtime viewers who have followed their relationship through years of uncertainty.

Erin Krakow and Kevin McGarry return as Elizabeth and Nathan. Their romance has developed against the backdrop of Elizabeth's earlier relationship with Lucas, making the prospect of a wedding particularly meaningful for viewers invested in the show's characters. Production on the new season has been nearing completion as the premiere approaches.

Season 14 will also bring back Lori Loughlin as Abigail Stanton, a character who previously left the series during its sixth season and was glimpsed again at the end of Season 13. The new season is scheduled to premiere January 3, 2027, at 8 p.m. Eastern on Hallmark Channel. The trailer offers a celebration, but fans will have to watch the season to discover how everything unfolds.
